representative_reference_groups.retirement_impact: A future apply must decide whether these stay as compatibility docs, switch to archive paths, or point to a compact gateway.
A future apply must keep package exclusion and release-blocker claims consistent after any old-anchor change.
Historical prose references can remain as archaeology only if the new canonical lookup path and alias policy are explicit.
Any tool that treats prism/reports as a live source must be migrated or protected before delete-last apply.

blockers.evidence: Four post-freeze formal reports exist under prism/reports and are not part of the P4-16 private archive cohort.
At least 94 non-report-root files still reference prism/reports anchors.
There is no checked redirect, alias resolver, or compatibility gateway that proves old anchors can be removed without breaking archaeology.
The current task explicitly forbids destructive migration and raw evidence cleanup.

future_apply_requirements: Refresh the report archive cohort or explicitly preserve every post-freeze report before retirement.
Create and validate an alias or lookup gateway so old report identifiers remain discoverable after physical old-anchor retirement.
Replace or classify non-report-root references to prism/reports as either canonical runtime references, compatibility references, or historical prose.
Run a dry-run that proves package surface, current-status, Prism degradation checks, docs catalog, task reports, and closeout receipts still resolve after the proposed change.
Obtain explicit authorization before any destructive delete-last apply.
Keep prism/runs raw evidence cleanup as a separate task with separate evidence-preservation proof.
rollback_plan: Because this task performs no physical deletion, rollback for this preflight is limited to reverting this manifest, checker, report, and backlog changes.
A future destructive apply must first generate a restorable manifest of every old anchor, target archive path, hash, alias, and reference update.
A future destructive apply must preserve a command-level restore plan before deleting any old anchor.

result.next_recommended_slice: internal-control-plane or a bounded old-anchor alias contract task, depending on Prism review
